name: o-json: find a key in help

actions.label: Switch the help layout
actions.caption: S switches the help view. Use it to compare the binding tree with the flat list.

actions.label: Read the previous help view
actions.caption: shift+tab cycles help backward. Return to the view that makes the key you need easiest to find.

actions.label: Read the next help view
actions.caption: tab changes how help presents the live bindings. Compare the views to find keys by noun or by their rows.

actions.label: Filter the binding list
actions.caption: / opens the help filter; type yank to narrow the rows. Find copying commands without reading every binding.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
